raw_endpoint_features: Reuse exact existing E1 cache; do not extract again.

ITI-style task adaptation.objective: Correct/incorrect answer completion activation probes and mean direction; no ASTER pair loss
ITI-style task adaptation.endpoints: All unique endpoints of the frozen 2540 pairs
ITI-style task adaptation.native_head_selection: Logistic probes C=1,max_iter=100; fit-source held-out sources[::5]; top51
ITI-style task adaptation.requires_gpu: Only missing correct/incorrect answer completion activations
ITI-style task adaptation.randomness: Deterministic lbfgs probe; random_state=11 retained for reproducibility, no fake seed variance.

LEACE-pair adaptation.objective: Existing pair-side signed A/P kind+subtype concept covariance erasure
LEACE-pair adaptation.shared_supervision: Frozen E1 M1 51-head positions; explicit ASTER A/P,C/F localization supervision. This is a task-adapted control, not standard LEACE.
LEACE-pair adaptation.effect_filter: Existing |delta logit| >=0.1 for AP only, retained unchanged; 2540 input pairs passed to old entry point.
LEACE-pair adaptation.standard_LEACE: Not implemented here: requires stable instance concept labels; delegated to separate new-erasure task.

SEA task adaptation.historical_results: Reuse complete historical scores and paths; do not repeat them.
SEA task adaptation.objective: Existing correct/incorrect completion spectral projection; no ASTER loss
SEA task adaptation.intervention: Official vendor AdapterLayer, final residual, l2_norm; no algorithm rewrite
SEA task adaptation.caveat: Singleton-token per-coordinate normalization can produce 0/0. Existing fallback must be described; GPU numeric parity unresolved.

hyperparameters: Single historical configuration fixed before E1 test; no historical test tuning.
evaluation: Development first, freeze settings; historical MEGA40/806 evaluation only if authorized. Do not repeat NLI500 or MedPIC188.
